title: The categories-plan linked-root test creates its fixture inside the gated worktree's .tmp, so a full gate can fence its own credit
outcome: A full gate's own tests never write inside the worktree the gate is carried in, so the host's watcher cannot refuse the gate's credit for a file the gate itself created. Today scripts/test-categories-plan.test.mjs:328 (the linked-root junction fixture added in c5a1f29) creates its fixture with mkdtempSync(join(projectRoot, ".tmp", "categories-fixture-")) inside the gated worktree. Occurrence: gate test-b8d91f08-8856-433b-9382-fca6cc7fd4de (w-4401e489b84d, .tmp/wt-category-cli-9474 at master 593c783) was refused while still running: "a file in its worktree changed: …\.tmp\categories-fixture-ME2NWO\real". Gates on bases containing c5a1f29 were credited before (w-837 test-c339cbe6, w-1313 test-7bccabe7), so whether the watcher sees it depends on timing. Fix direction, to decide: (a) the test places its fixture outside the gated worktree but inside the repository (for example the main checkout's .tmp, found through git's common dir), or the test temp root; or (b) the host's watcher ignores paths git ignores, since content_revision never counts them. (b) is a host change and needs an architect.
acceptance: A full gate's own fixtures create nothing inside the gated worktree, or the host does not fence a carried gate for a change that cannot alter its source revision; a test shows the categories-plan linked-root test no longer writes under the gated worktree (or that an ignored-path change does not fence).
The linked-root accounting test still covers a UI root reached through a directory link.
A full gate on master passes and is credited to the item it was launched for.
